notes.title: Patch 0.762 has been released.
notes.notes:
Hotfix patch 0.762 has been released.

[h1][b] Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Enabled Cloud server region setting
[/list]

[h1][b] Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Shader bugs of Mac version  
[/list]

I'm planning [b]huge update[/b] during this summer.
The update will include below:
[list]
    [*]Enable hero units each tribes. They can use activities costing resource "Food". 
    [*]Increase minions' battle AI
    [*]Campaign mode of Dobu tribe
[/list]and more

Thank you for your support.

BOHDOKUMEN.

notes.title: Patch 0.761 has been released.
notes.notes:
Hotfix patch 0.761 has been released.

[h1][b] Fixed [/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Terrain grass texture brightness fixed
    [*]Units pathfinding system fixed
[/list]

[h1][b] Remaking HUD [/b][/h1]
I'm remaking HUD in many ways. The version changed main color is below:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29075106/c5dafa8a620d8052e239905a48f2c064e279a4ba.png[/img]
The color of current version is green. Some people say current version blends in to terrain color. I'll keep trying to make hud better.

[h1][b] Future Updates [/b][/h1]
I'll focus on enriching minion battle AI and singleplayer modes first.


Thank you for your support.

BOHDOKUMEN.

notes.title: First Patch released.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Thank you for your opinions. Patch released.

[h1][b] Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Enabled unit creation canceling (Right-Clicking Button)
    [*]Enabled selecting all units of same type in screen (Double-Clicking Unit)
[/list]

[h1][b] BugFixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Pathfinding system
    [*]Fog of war system of some buildings bugs
    [*]HUD information bugs
    [*]Multiplayer setting bugs
    [*]Multiplayer too much dead bodies bugs
    [*]Multiplayer Synchronization bugs
    [*]Selecting no unit bug
[/list]


[h1][b] Upcoming Updates[/b][/h1]

I'll fix bugs and start remaking HUD next week. I'll show  you several drafts of new HUD in the middle of next week.


Thank you for your support.

BOHDOKUMEN.
